824-2728-4050-6012.easyPrerequisites:
Genestealer Patriarch does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent controls a creature.
Leech Bonder is tapped and does not have summoning sickness.
824-2728-4050-6012.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two additional creatures.
824-2728-4050-6012.description:
Declare Genestealer Patriarch as an attacker.
Genestealer Patriarch's first ability triggers, putting an infection counter on a creature an opponent controls.
Activate Leech Bonder's ability by paying its cost, moving the infection counter from the opponent's creature onto a creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with an infection counter on it, adding one mana of any color.
When the creature dies, Reluctant Role Model and Genestealer Patriarch's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Reluctant Role Model trigger, putting an infection counter onto another creature you control.
Resolve the Genestealer Patriarch trigger, causing you to create a token copy of the sacrificed creature that is a Tyranid in addition to its other types.
Repeat from step 4.

654-2557-4094-6753-7942.easyPrerequisites: At least two loyalty counters on Kaya.
654-2557-4094-6753-7942.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Amulet of Vigor triggers eight times, untapping the New Planet tokens.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat from step 2

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

1242-1424-4613-7891.description:
Activate Woodland Weavemaster using the ability granted to it by Presence of Gond by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Elf Warrior creature token.
When the Elf Warrior enters, Woodland Weavemaster triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Woodland Weavemaster using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on Woodland Weavemaster, untapping Woodland Weavemaster.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

624-670-1619-5241.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
624-670-1619-5241.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Sakashima's Student and Phantasmal Image each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Sakashima's Student trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Phantasmal Image trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
624-670-1619-5241.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Radiant Solar
as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1603-1619-4264.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1603-1619-4264.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Altered Ego and Evil Twin each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Altered Ego trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Evil Twin trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1603-1619-4264.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without a slumber counter on it

3201-4644-7791.description:
Activate Arixmethes by tapping it, adding {G}{U}.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Arixmethes.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Arixmethes.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more counters on it

687-2404-4693-6099.notablePrerequisites:
There are three removable counters among creatures you control excluding the first three +1/+1 counters on Mossborn Hydra.
You control at least three creatures.
687-2404-4693-6099.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {3}.
Activate Overgrown Estate by sacrificing Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Tayam by paying {3} and removing three counters from creatures you control, causing you to mill three cards and return Gaea's Cradle from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Gaea's Cradle enters, Mossborn Hydra triggers, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.
687-2404-4693-6099.notes: The prerequisite can be waived if Mossborn Hydra has six or more counters on it.

2653-3875-5856-7513.description:
Activate a Food using Silkwing Scout's ability by paying {G} and sacrificing it, searching your library for a basic land card and putting it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Nissa and Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating a Food token and adding {G}.
Repeat.

628-2921-5007.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.
628-2921-5007.notes: The remaining -1/-1 counter can be removed each loop to gain infinite colored mana.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3899-4552-6774-7290.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Does Machines
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

4779-6972-7156.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Arcbound Hybrid.
When Arcbound Hybrid dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Hybrid's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Hybrid from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Krark-Clan Grunt ability.
Repeat.

3110-5078-5642.easyPrerequisites: "Sensei's Divining Top" chosen with Council of the Absolute.
3110-5078-5642.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Echoes of Eternity triggers, creating a copy of the Sensei's Divining Top spell.
Resolve both Sensei's Divining Top spells.
Activate the nontoken Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate the token Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top, and causing you to put the token Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

630-2366-4359-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-2366-4359-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

343-2366-3480-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
343-2366-3480-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Regal Behemoth triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Avatar Kuruk

1409-3908-7009.manaNeeded: {1}{U} plus {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn
1409-3908-7009.description:
Activate Spark Double using Avatar Kuruk's ability by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spark Double by paying {1}{U}, blinking it. Choose to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Avatar Kuruk.
When Spark Double enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability triggers, repairing it and Spark Double.
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-4352-6972--112.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Maulfist Squad.
When Maulfist Squad dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Maulfist Squad enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.
2438-4352-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost Maulfist Squad's toughness by at least 1 so it doesn't die from the -1/-1 counter.

997-3560-6888.description:
Cast Traveling Plague by paying {3}{B}{B}, attaching it to another creature you control.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing the creature Traveling Plague is attached to.
When the creature dies, Traveling Plague triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the token created in step 2.
When Traveling Plague enters, Archon of Sun's Grace triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1170-1418-4124-5954-6664.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens, which enter untapped due to The Wandering Minstrel.
Resolve the Whip Silk spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

678-2811-5670.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using one colored mana with the mana to cast it.
678-2811-5670.description:
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing the creature.
When the creature dies, Enduring Renewal and Elas il-Kor's second ability trigger.
Resolve the Enduring Renewal trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Elas il-Kor trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

803-1238-2351-2921-5467.description:
During an opponent's turn, activate Heart of Kiran by tapping Wylie Duke.
Wylie Duke triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Watcher's first ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
Resolve the Heart of Kiran ability, causing it to become a creature until end of turn.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Tentacle.
When the Tentacle dies, The Watcher's second ability triggers, untapping Wylie Duke and putting a stun counter on up to one permanent.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability
Repeat.

uses.n: Optimus Prime, Hero // Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader

997-2018-5263.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Hero.
When Optimus Prime, Hero dies, its second ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader.
When Optimus Prime, Autobot Leader dies, Luminous Broodmoth triggers, returning Optimus Prime from your graveyard to the battlefield as Optimus Prime, Hero with a flying counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from steps 1 and 3, causing you to scry 1 twice.
Repeat.

2757-4893-5685.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one basic Forest.
2757-4893-5685.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Propagator Drone by paying {1}{G}, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Eldrazi Spawn, untapping the basic Forest.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.

2178-3113-4227.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-3113-4227.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1523-3018-3197-4050.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1523-3018-3197-4050.description:
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to any other creature you control.
When Rancor enters the battlefield, Eutropia triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Herd Baloth.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a 4/4 Beast creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
Rancor triggers, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1048-3168-4659-5121.notablePrerequisites:
"Myr" chosen with Urza's Incubator.
You have a Myr card in hand with mana value two or less that can be cast for {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
You control a nontoken Myr with mana value two or less that can be cast for {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
1048-3168-4659-5121.description:
Cast the Myr with mana value two or less in your hand by paying {0} due to Urza's Incubator.
Urtet and Equilibrium trigger.
Resolve the Urtet trigger, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Myr token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Equilibrium trigger, causing you to pay {1} to return the Myr with mana value two or less currently on the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
 At the beginning of your combat phase, Urtet's second ability triggers, untapping all Myr you control.

224-1737-3281-4832.notablePrerequisites:
Ensoul Artifact attached to Prototype Portal.
Prototype Portal does not have summoning sickness.
224-1737-3281-4832.description:
Activate Prototype Portal by tapping it, creating a token copy of Great Furnace.
When the Great Furnace token enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers, untapping Prototype Portal.
Repeat.

3129-3317-4050-4124.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
3129-3317-4050-4124.description:
Cast Whip Silk by paying {G}, attaching it to any creature you control.
Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Historian's Boon's first ability, creating two 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing the creature with Whip Silk attached and a Soldier token, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
